company.name: Polars
company.shortDescription: Polars develops open-source DataFrame software for data processing, transformation, querying, and data manipulation.
company.description: Polars is an open-source data analytics platform built on a Rust query engine for high-performance processing of structured datasets. The company supports lazy and eager execution, streaming for larger-than-memory workloads, automatic query optimization, and parallel computation. The platform integrates with Apache Arrow, Delta Lake, cloud object storage, databases, and common file formats including Parquet, CSV, JSON, and Avro.

productsAndServices.description: An open-source, high-performance DataFrame library for Python, Rust, and JavaScript that supports data manipulation, querying, transformation, and analysis on a single machine.
productsAndServices.name: Polars

productsAndServices.description: A managed platform for running Polars queries on cloud or on-premises infrastructure, with scalable compute and the same API used by the open-source library.
productsAndServices.name: Polars Cloud

productsAndServices.description: A paid support program providing enterprise users with prioritized bug handling, feature-request consideration, developer consultations, nightly builds, and team training.
productsAndServices.name: Polars Enterprise Support

productsAndServices.description: A professional training service that teaches organizations how to use Polars for data manipulation, time-series analysis, nested data, performance optimization, and custom extensions.
productsAndServices.name: Polars Academy

productsAndServices.description: A major release of the Polars open-source data-processing library that defaults LazyFrame queries to a streaming engine for improved memory efficiency and performance.
productsAndServices.name: Polars 2.0
